description: We are a team of students from Sultan Moulay Slimane University (USMS), in the Beni Mellal-Khenifra region. With backgrounds in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, we have skills in Python programming, machine learning, data analysis, and data visualization. We are working on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data, aiming to develop a web-based tool that uses NASA POWER climate data to support local farmers in making better crop rotation decisions, optimizing water use.
